name: Topple
description: A physics toy with a sling: a hundred easy levels in five worlds, two of them at night under swinging lamps. Levels are prefabs dropped into a world's scene; 2D lights and shadows on normal-mapped sprites, joints, breakable blocks, particles, parallax, a full interface, sound, and progress saved between visits. Also runs in a browser, phones included.
author: Duarte Peixinho
